captions.caption: A man inside a primitive hut hangs a woven mat from the thatched ceiling.
He secures the woven mat to the wooden beams supporting the roof.
The man adjusts the hanging mat while kneeling on the dirt floor.
He pulls on the mat to ensure it is properly fastened to the ceiling.
The man takes the mat down and holds it in front of him.
He carefully inspects the texture and weave of the handmade mat.
The man turns the mat over to examine the other side.
He begins to work with a cord attached to one corner of the mat.
The man focuses on manipulating the cord with his fingers.
He uses a small wooden tool to adjust the binding on the mat.
The man continues to work on the edge of the mat with the cord.
He finishes his adjustments and prepares to re-hang the mat.
The man holds the mat up, checking its overall appearance.
He reaches up to the ceiling to re-attach the woven mat.
The man hooks the mat's ties onto the thatched roof structure.
He adjusts the mat as it hangs, ensuring it is level.
The man pulls on the strings to tighten the connection to the roof.
He continues to fine-tune the position of the hanging mat.
The man moves his hands along the mat, smoothing the surface.
He steps back to look at the mat hanging in the hut.
The man reaches out to make a final adjustment to the mat.
He continues to work on the hanging mat, ensuring it is perfect.
The man looks closely at the top edge of the woven material.
He uses a small stick to poke at the thatched roof near the mat.
The man takes the mat down once more and starts to roll it.
He rolls the mat into a tight cylinder using both hands.
The man unrolls the mat and spreads it out on his lap.
He holds the mat up to the light coming through the hut's entrance.
The man flips the mat over to inspect the reverse side again.
He carefully examines the weave for any inconsistencies.
The man continues his thorough inspection of the handmade mat.
He shakes the mat slightly to clear any loose fibers.
The man holds the mat taut, checking the strength of the weave.
He brings the mat close to his eyes for a detailed inspection.
The man sets the mat down and picks up a long piece of cord.
He begins to wrap the cord around the folded woven mat.
The man continues binding the mat, securing it with several wraps.
He pulls the cord tight to keep the mat from unrolling.
The man continues to wrap the cord around the middle of the mat.
He focuses on binding the mat neatly and securely.
The man prepares to tie a knot to finish the binding.
He ties a final knot in the cord around the mat.
The man inspects the bound mat, ensuring the knot is tight.
He holds the bound mat, showing the finished product.
The man sets the bound mat aside and picks up a piece of bark cloth.
He begins to unfold the large, soft piece of bark cloth.
The man spreads the bark cloth out over his lap.
He brings the cloth up to his face to smell the material.
The man continues to examine the texture of the bark cloth.
He runs his hands over the surface of the cloth, checking for softness.
The man begins to fold the large bark cloth into a square.
He continues folding the cloth, smoothing out any wrinkles.
The man holds the folded cloth and looks thoughtfully at it.
He sets the folded cloth down and looks around the hut.
The man prepares to start a new task in his home.
A close-up shows the man's hands sewing a piece of leather.
He uses a needle to pierce the thick animal hide.
The man pulls a long thread through the hide to create a stitch.
He continues sewing the hide with careful, deliberate movements.
The man focuses on joining the leather pieces together.
